subject: general
question:
Seven boxes, N, O, T, F, A, R and M, are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order. M is kept immediately above A. N is kept immediately above O. Only T is kept above F. Only two boxes are kept above M. N is not kept at third position from the bottom.

How many boxes are kept between R and T?
solution:
Seven boxes, N, O, T, F, A, R and M, are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order.

 
• M is kept immediately above A.
 
• N is kept immediately above O.
 
• Only T is kept above F.
 
• Only two boxes are kept above M.
 
• N is not kept at third position from the bottom.

The Final Arrangement is ,

 
 

 
 
T

 
 
 

 
 
F

 
 
 

 
 
M

 
 
 

 
 
A

 
 
 

 
 
R

 
 
 

 
 
N

 
 
 

 
 
O

 
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**
